description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_Literals, which provides methods for managing literals within the Smarty template engine, including getting, setting, and adding literals, with internal handling for duplicate and delimiter conflicts.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_Literals
classes.description: Provides methods for managing literals in Smarty templates, including retrieving, setting, and appending literals, with internal validation to prevent delimiter conflicts.

methods.name: getLiterals
methods.description: Retrieves the list of literals from a Smarty template object.

methods.name: addLiterals
methods.description: Adds literals to the Smarty template object.

methods.name: setLiterals
methods.description: Sets the literals for the Smarty template object, replacing existing literals.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Internal method to set literals in Smarty, ensuring delimiters are not duplicated.
